In the rolling 30-day UTC window from 2026-08-08 through 2026-09-06, 23 of 30 days are active; the current streak is 19 days; the peak is 1043 contributions on September 04, 2026. Color encodes GitHub contribution levels 0 through 4 while each date preserves its raw GitHub contribution count. Source: GitHub GraphQL contribution calendar. Headline metrics use GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs. Generation refresh: every hour; execution and README cache propagation are best-effort. Evidence ID SF1-A4E3A97A65CA7C5F is the deterministic identity of the measured Signal Field evidence semantics shared by all four responsive variants.
